stem.en: Ravi lends ₹10,000 by buying a bond that pays 5% interest a year. He holds it for one year and then receives the interest and the money he lent, because the bond matures. How many rupees does he receive in all, at the end of that year?

explanation.en: Interest for one year is 5% of ₹10,000, which is ₹500. At maturity the borrower returns the ₹10,000 lent as well, so Ravi receives ₹10,000 + ₹500 = ₹10,500. The ₹10,000 is his own money coming back; only the ₹500 is what the bond earned.

hints.en: First find the interest for one year: 5% of ₹10,000.
At maturity the borrower returns the amount lent as well as the interest, so add both.
